text: Add a button to terminate chat generation. And make enter button stop sending the message but adding new line.
I've found the composer and the conversation view; now reading how the run's Stop works to put a stop button in the composer.
Each chat turn ends its run and the next message resumes it, so stopping generation is just killing the active turn. Now editing.
Now updating the Sessions screen card to match.

The chat now has a stop button, and Enter adds a new line instead of sending.

- **Stop button:** while the agent is answering, a round stop button sits next to Send in the message box. Pressing it ends the current answer. Whatever the agent wrote before you stopped it still lands. Your next message picks the chat up where it stopped.
- **Enter:** Enter adds a new line. You send with the Send button. On a keyboard, I kept Ctrl+Enter (Cmd+Enter on a Mac) as a shortcut for sending. That part is my addition, so tell me if you'd rather Send be the only way.

The changes are in `apps/app/src/ui/Composer.tsx` and `apps/app/src/ui/Conversation.tsx`. The end-to-end test helpers in `apps/backend/e2e/support/app.ts` sent messages by pressing Enter, so they now press Ctrl+Enter. I also updated the [Sessions screen](Frontend/Screen/chat) card to describe the new behaviour.

**Not tested yet:** this copy of the code doesn't have its dependencies installed, so I couldn't type-check it, run the e2e tests or look at it in Firefox. Please try it in the app once it lands.
